name: AccountUsage
description: Reach for this when a playbook starts failing PolySwarm actions. Reports the account, plan and remaining quota behind the configured key, so you can tell whether it is a bad key, an unsupported feature, or spent quota. Never returns the API key.

account_name.description: Name of the account the API key belongs to

account_type.description: Account type, for example user or team

daily_api_limit.description: Daily API request allowance, or null when the plan does not meter daily requests

daily_api_remaining.description: Daily API requests still available, or null when the plan does not meter daily requests

exhausted_features.description: Names of the features whose remaining uses have reached zero, which is the usual reason a working playbook starts failing

features.description: Per feature quota as the platform meters it. The plan decides what appears here, so scans, hunting and sandbox detonations are entries in this list rather than fields of their own

tag.description: Feature tag used by the platform

base_uses.description: Uses included for the plan period, or null when the feature is not metered by count

remaining_uses.description: Uses still available in the plan period, or null when the feature is not metered by count

overage.description: Uses consumed beyond the included allowance, or null when the feature allows no overage

kind.description: Feature kind as the platform reports it. A boolean feature is an entitlement that is on or off rather than a quota

enabled.description: Whether a boolean entitlement is switched on. Null for a metered feature

unlimited.description: True when the platform reports the allowance as unmetered

has_stream_access.description: Whether the account may consume the PolySwarm stream

is_trial.description: Whether the account is on a trial plan

plan_name.description: Name of the plan or tier the account is on

plan_period_end.description: End of the current plan period, which is when metered quotas reset

plan_period_start.description: Start of the current plan period

tenant.description: Tenant the account belongs to, empty on accounts with no tenant
